# The ARC Raiders Hub
> The premier community database, guides, loadout builder, and news intelligence hub for ARC Raiders by Embark Studios (PS5, PC, Xbox Series X|S).

## Core Tactical Guides & Field Dossiers
- [Weapons & Loadout Guide](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/arc-raiders-best-weapons-gadgets-loadout-guide): Complete weapon tier lists, gadget synergies, and DPS meta.
- [Speranza Colony Contracts](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/speranza-colony-arc-raiders-extraction-contracts-guide): Extraction mechanics, underground trader rep, and mission blueprints.
- [Titan Boss Weakpoints](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/arc-raiders-titan-boss-fight-weakpoints-loot-guide): Machine boss strategies, core component drops, and combat tactics.
- [PS5 Gameplay & Settings](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/arc-raiders-ps5-gameplay-release-date-guide): 4K 60FPS performance, DualSense haptics, and console controls.
- [PC Unreal Engine 5 FPS Guide](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/arc-raiders-pc-settings-unreal-engine-5-fps-guide): Lumen, Nanite, DLSS/FSR optimization for competitive framerates.
- [Crossplay & Cross-Progression](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/is-arc-raiders-crossplay-cross-platform-guide): Cross-platform matchmaking and account linking details.
- [Sentinel Firing Core Farm](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/where-to-find-sentinel-firing-core-in-arc-raiders-farm-guide): High-tier crafting material locations and Sentinel spawns.
- [Mushroom Farming Locations](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/where-to-find-mushrooms-in-arc-raiders-ultimate-farming-guide): Underground flora spots and Speranza medical craft recipes.
- [Olives Scavenging Guide](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/where-to-find-olives-in-arc-raiders-ultimate-loot-guide): Surface grocery cache locations and food provisioning.
- [Ultimate Scavenging Guide](https://www.thearc-raiders.com/what-we-left-behind-arc-raiders-ultimate-scavenging-guide): Loot route optimization and safe extraction corridors.
